meta.title: The journey of QUO-0221 · Clafina
meta.description: Follow one sale through Clafina: a quote ⟦n:customer⟧ can answer, an invoice that writes itself, a waybill signed at the door, and books that post themselves.

hero.title: The journey of QUO-0221
hero.lede: One quotation, eleven moments, five people and a van. Follow forty cartons of tomato paste from ⟦n:sales⟧'s laptop to ⟦n:customer⟧'s shop, and watch every paper write the next one by itself.

chapters.title: ⟦n:sales⟧ writes a quote
chapters.text: ⟦n:customer⟧ from ⟦n:shop⟧ wants forty cartons of tomato paste. ⟦n:sales⟧ picks the item, Clafina fills in the price, the ⟦t:label⟧ and how long the offer stands. One minute, no spreadsheet.

chapters.title: Sealed, and on its way
chapters.text: The quote folds into its envelope and flies to ⟦n:customer⟧ as a link, by email or a chat app. He does not need an account to open it.

chapters.title: ⟦n:customer⟧ names his own price
chapters.text: ⟦n:customer⟧ can accept, or answer with his own price on the same page. He offers ⟦m:quo.offer⟧ a carton instead of ⟦m:quo.price⟧. Every offer is kept, line by line.

chapters.title: A deal in five minutes
chapters.text: ⟦m:quo.offer⟧ is inside ⟦n:sales⟧'s discount limit, so she accepts on the spot. Above her limit, it would have gone to ⟦n:manager⟧ first. The quote is stamped agreed.

chapters.title: The invoice writes itself
chapters.text: One tap turns the agreed quote into invoice INV-0412, with a Pay now link inside. Nobody types the lines again, so nothing is mistyped.

chapters.title: ⟦n:manager⟧ approves the order
chapters.text: Sales order SO-0187 asks for approval because it is a large one. ⟦n:manager⟧ checks ⟦n:shop⟧' credit on her phone, it is clear, and she approves from a meeting.

chapters.title: ⟦n:warehouse⟧ picks and packs
chapters.text: The order appears on ⟦n:warehouse⟧'s pick list in the warehouse. He scans forty cartons; Main store drops from 120 to 80 as each one leaves the shelf.

chapters.title: ⟦n:driver⟧ takes the road
chapters.text: Waybill WB-0097 goes with the load. ⟦n:sales⟧ and ⟦n:customer⟧ can both see it move. Send it in the van, or on a bike for a small order: try the switch above the scene.

chapters.title: Signed at the door
chapters.text: ⟦n:customer⟧ counts forty cartons and signs on ⟦n:driver⟧'s phone. Name, time and signature are kept on the waybill, so there is never a "we never got it".

chapters.title: ⟦n:customer⟧ pays from the invoice
chapters.text: ⟦n:customer⟧ opens INV-0412 and taps Pay now. The money reaches Bright Harbour Traders and Clafina matches it to the invoice by itself.

chapters.title: A receipt, and the books agree
chapters.text: In the same minute the receipt goes to ⟦n:customer⟧ and the books are posted: sales, ⟦t:label⟧, the bank, and ⟦n:shop⟧ owing nothing. Six papers, one record, and nobody typed anything twice.
